edits.before:
The sheet is a compact working inventory of generators and relations for the displayed objects \(E_0,E_1,E_2\). Four directed arrows form the main diagram. The framed formulas record the displayed identities, an involution and an idempotent, the two \(\sigma\)-relations, the invariance of \(\delta_1\delta_0\), and a final relation for \(p_0p_{12}\). Five ovals group the live generator lists and the three primed-\(\delta\) definitions; the two rows of each common frame stay together.

The group signs were reread because the expected permutation-group letter can bias the reading. Each local glyph has the open rounded bowl, curled tip and inward return of the current supplied \(\mathcal G\) convention, so all three are encoded as \(\mathcal G\), at medium confidence. A native-view suspicion that the second primed definition might have a right-hand subscript 1 was settled by its crop: the curved head and foot form 2, so the agreed \(\delta'_2=\delta_2\sigma\) stands. In the final box the small sigma index visually favors 1; root's explicitly conditional coordinate-consistency check favored that admissible reading over 3. This is not a claim that a computation identifies the ink. No proof check was performed by this reader.

The small cancelled heading line and cancelled id-like draft remain doubtful. The six-p oval's 3-like upper-right mark cannot be separated securely from its curled closure, and the final \(q_1|p_1\) label remains overtraced. No separate cancelled p is invented there. The p21 underlabel and the final label's descender are crossed by frame boundaries, not cancellation strokes. The upper inventory is abandoned as a block, although its left-column p0/p1 and delta0 are not physically struck. Both commas after the crossed delta0 products survive. The written “(involution” has no closing parenthesis.

There is no title, date or numbered equation. The author wrote a dark circled 2 at the head; the thin 4 at the foot is later foliation and is preserved as a margin item. Seven framed areas, five ovals and the circled author number are present. The line count of 35 counts writing baselines by independent display/list, including diagram labels, underlabels and the two numbers; it does not count each mathematical object as a separate line.
### Root check and resolution of the final sigma index

The whole last formula and its enlarged detail show a short upright with a small lower/right swelling, without the two separately visible lobes used for clear 3 elsewhere on this leaf. This favors sigma1. The coordinate check `151-coordinate-26` gives p0 p12 sigma1(x,y,z)=x=p0 p12(x,y,z), whereas the competing3 gives y (`151-coordinate-27`). The ink is compatible with1 and its own notation supports that reading, so M0750 is resolved to1 at medium confidence. This is not a silent correction of a clearly written3. The underlabel remains q1|p1 because both opposing bowls are visible in the overtraced letter and their sequence cannot be separated confidently.

The sigma involution and delta0 p0 idempotent captions were checked by substitution (`151-coordinate-28` and `29`). The central three-value box, the E0 identities, and the sigma1 stabilizer identity repeat the coordinate relations already computed for151_scan003; no independent general presentation theorem is claimed. The clear sigma1 delta1=delta1 on this leaf is consistent with that model, unlike the explicit sigma3 in the corresponding box on151_scan003. All of these leaf-specific indices are transcribed as read.

### Blind crop adjudication

The left p0/p1 and delta0 of the upper inventory are physically unstruck and are now live. The middle lists and delta1–3 group are crossed; the small separately canceled sigma-like draft remains uncertain, and both commas after the crossed delta0 composites remain live. A distinct dark upright above main-diagram E2 is retained as prime/dot uncertain. The direct delta0 arrow, curved delta1 arrow, live G2/G3 letters and the shouldered frame agree.

The central rho-delta and rho-squared-delta annotations, and the final p0p12 underannotation, have square-ended brackets. The sigma p12 annotation in the side relation box has a genuine central cusp and remains a brace. Common-frame scope is unchanged, while separate corner strokes, pen gaps and the doubled upper-left return of the central frame are drawn. The primed-definition oval is kept open at its clipped right edge, the six-p closing curl remains3-like uncertain on its outline, and both smaller list ovals retain their closing returns. The canceled p-pair separator remains comma/slash uncertain. The final sigma index remains1 on its visible upright; no equation is repaired from expected algebra.
